content: Great puzzle, but i would had test cases were you only have single letter, (e.g. one `AAAA`, one `BB`, and one `CCC`)

Wow! Pretty difficult Reverse puzzle for me, but I did eventually manage to figure it out on my own (took about 3 minutes to spot the pattern). Do you think there's any way to make the pattern easier to spot, or is me spotting it in 3 minutes what you wanted?

BTW, I think this is a fabulous reverse puzzle!

Hahah, thank you for the compliments!
I can change test 2 to be only "A"s and test 3 to be only "B"s, but I'm afraid this would make it too obvious.
You can't use a string made up only of Cs as input, because the output would be an empty string, which isn't allowed on this platform.

Thank you!
That make sense, but would be too easy and less of a challenge if players could instantly spot the patterns of A and B.
The plan is for players to figure out C first, then figure out A in test 2 and finally B in test 3.

What if for test 2, you do ACAA because when I saw that test for the first time, I thought the C added 3 "A"s to the end? So putting the "C" in the middle would avoid that confusion. I think Test 3 is good as it is though. Thanks!
Good point. In my head, C was the easiest pattern to spot, so players could figure out A in test 2, after that, they could figure out B in test 3.
